nonblocking.title: The reserved-total allowance is bounded in code, but nothing pins WHICH rows feed it: a mutant widening it to every non-accepted row's job survives the whole E4B list
nonblocking.evidence: certify.py:545-548 takes `cancelled` only from rows whose outcome is bench.CANCELLED_REPLAY and counts only those jobs' holds still `held`, by amount - bounded, not blanket. Verifier probe test_q5_allowance_is_exactly_the_cancelled_holds: a leaked hold on an unrelated job with reserved 0->2 FAILs ('reserved 0 -> 2 (1.00000000 held for the interruption's cancels)'); an accepted job's held hold FAILs 'holds still held'; a usage record on the cancelled job FAILs 'Σ charged 2.00000000 != ledger fall 2.5'. But verifier mutant v_cancelled_from_any_non_accepted (`if row.get("outcome") == bench.CANCELLED_REPLAY} - {None}` -> `if row.get("outcome") != "accepted"} - {None}`) SURVIVED the lane's CANCELLED, LEDGER and DATASET cases through the shared R83 runner ('3 passed'). Under it, a quarantined item's job (admitted, then refused at the rechecks, 400 with its Inference-Id) whose hold leaked is hidden. The verifier case test_kill_v_cancelled_from_any_non_accepted kills it (probes/test_verifier_probes.py:216: assert [] == ["reserved 0 ...n's cancels)"]). The blanket version (drop the request_id filter) IS killed by the lane's LEDGER case (test_certify.py:478). Fails closed today, like E4B-verify-7b5dbd7 V5.
nonblocking.fix: Add the case: a rejected (400) row carrying inference_id job-q1 whose hold is still held, reserved up by its amount, must FAIL 'reserved ...'; add mutant v_cancelled_from_any_non_accepted to e4b_mutants.py under CANCELLED.

nonblocking.title: R106 cause attribution: a first-run PLATFORM failure whose job was cancelled is counted 'cancelled by the interruption' and the drill passes (before 7ac77c7 it failed)
nonblocking.evidence: Verifier probe test_q6_a_first_run_platform_cancel_is_labelled_the_interruptions: first run i2 failed stream_error_event/status_unknown (not in flight at the SIGINT), i4 torn (ReadError); both replay state_conflict -> resume_problems == [] and sop_property says '2 item(s) cancelled by the interruption'. relay.py:625-636 cancels a job with cause client_cancelled whenever the relay cannot continue (store gone, journal gap) and emits the error, so a platform-side stream failure replays exactly like a SIGINT tear. R106's text sanctions counting every cancelled replay as terminal ('cancelled by the interruption'), so this follows the ruling; the drill's label overclaims the cause.
nonblocking.fix: Coordinator decision. Suggested: count as 'cancelled by the interruption' only items whose first-run row was a client-side tear (a transport error_class, not stream_error_event), and FAIL or list separately the others.

nonblocking.title: R106's text disagrees with the gateway and the contract in two places (ruling wording, not lane code)
nonblocking.evidence: (a) R106 says a job cancelled 'by ... the deadline' replays state_conflict with infrx.state=cancelled; relay.py:493-495 answers expired/deadline causes as deadline_exceeded, which bench keeps a non-terminal failure (SOP §3.6: 504 -> retry), so such a key is re-sent forever by a resume. The drill follows the conformance case: a usage record on a cancelled job FAILs Σ charged (lane test_certify.py:524-526; verifier probe). Also, a stream journal_expired replay stays non-terminal in bench while SOP §3.6 says re-derive and re-run - pre-existing, not R106's.
nonblocking.fix: Coordinator: align R106's wording with relay._refusal and the DUR-SETTLE conformance case.

answers.q2_bias: Rule (certify.py:1030-1043): the supported rate is the highest rung, climbing from the lowest, whose failure_rate (< 0.01 of within-cap attempts), answered (>= 1 accepted), rejections (zero within-cap refusals of ANY status, :1008) and client_exit (0) all PASS; the climb stops at the first failing rung. Over-cap rows are dropped by judged() before failures/answered/rejections (:995), soak (:1051) and overload (:1081); bench exits 0 whenever anything was accepted, so 400s do not touch client_exit. Verifier probe test_q2_rerun_ladder_supports_half_per_second: r0.5 = 112 accepted + 8 typed over-cap 400 -> rejections pass, duration_cap pass, failure_rate '0/112'; r1.0 with 3 x 429 capacity_exhausted -> rejections FAIL; envelope (PASS, 0.5). The same 8 over-cap refusals at r1.0 with no 429 -> supported 1.0 (they never lower it). Lane mutant over_cap_refusals_bias_the_rate killed test_certify.py:921; overload_counts_capped_clips killed :1042; verifier v_rejections_ignore_429 killed :945 (assert 'pass' == 'fail'). So r=1.0 with 3 x 429 is NOT supported; the box rerun's supported rate is 0.5/s.

answers.q4_r106_bench: Header: bench.py:933 `resp.headers.get("idempotency-replayed") == "true"` - exact value, stored as a bool, never verbatim (probe: 'True' -> False, row value always a bool). Classification bench.py:892-894 needs outcome failed + allowlisted code state_conflict + replayed True. Fresh state_conflict (no header) stays failed/non-terminal (probe; lane e1bm27 killed test_bench.py:586). A replay's other codes - journal_expired, result_expired, deadline_exceeded, status_unknown, stream_interrupted - stay failed/non-terminal (probe; lane e1bm28 killed test_bench.py:582). SOP §3.6: deadline_exceeded -> retry, so non-terminal is right; journal_expired/result_expired -> re-derive and re-run: bench treats an HTTP 410 as terminal but a STREAM journal_expired as a re-sendable failure (pre-existing, N6). R106 vs relay on the deadline cause: N6. e1bm07 re-anchor is honest: death at test_bench.py:538 'AssertionError: accepted items are done' (skipped_terminal_on_resume becomes 6, not 3). e1bm25-29 deaths: :576, :573, :586, :582, :577, all AssertionError.
answers.q5_ledger_allowance: certify.py:545-551: cancelled = inference ids of CANCELLED_REPLAY rows only; kept = sum of those jobs' hold.amount whose state is 'held'; reserved must equal before + kept exactly. Bounded by job and amount, not a blanket (probe: a leaked unrelated hold, reserved 0 -> 2, FAILs). A held hold on an ACCEPTED job still FAILs 'holds still held' independently (certify.py:534-537). A usage record on the cancelled job FAILs Σ charged, because Σ charged counts only accepted jobs' records against the ledger's full fall (lane test_certify.py:524-526; probe 'Σ charged 2.00000000 != ledger fall 2.5'). Lane mutants: cancel_holds_unaccounted :519, released_cancel_holds_counted :520; verifier blanket mutant v_blanket_hold_allowance killed :478. The row filter itself is not pinned (N1).

box_command_requirements: Run certify.py inside the container with `docker run ... --env-file /etc/marlin2b-gateway.env ...` (already in E4B-9aa7ffe.md steps at :190 and :449). deployed_cap_s() reads MAX_VIDEO_SECONDS from the certify process's own environment, so this flag is how the deployed 82 reaches it.
Do not pass `-e MAX_VIDEO_SECONDS=...` on that docker run. An -e value overrides the env-file, so it would split the runner's cap from the gateway's.

The running gateway must have been started from the same /etc/marlin2b-gateway.env content (MAX_VIDEO_SECONDS=82; rollout runbook §1). If the file was edited after the gateway started, restart the gateway before the window. Otherwise the caps differ and the parity/envelope/overload/dataset cells FAIL.

Flags: --no-stack --box --target http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1 --engine-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --metrics-url http://127.0.0.1:8001/metrics --worker-metrics-url http://127.0.0.1:8002/metrics --release-sha <full release SHA> --inventory <inventory.sh output> --parity-baseline <W4 E0 parity.jsonl> --report <path>.

Environment: E4B_WINDOW_OK=1 (window.env), INFRX_API_KEY (key.env), DATABASE_URL (from the gateway env file, for the ledger half), CORPUS_CACHE=/corpus, INFRX_CERTIFY_GATEWAY_IMAGE. The workdir must be writable: the default is a mkdtemp inside the container; corpus-within-cap.json is written there, and /repo is read-only.
After the run, check that report target.max_video_seconds == 82.0 and e4b.b.config-pin measured.deployed_max_video_seconds == 82.0. The runner does not refuse a missing cap; it reads 120 (N8).
